promotion_criteria.title: Mathiyon SLM v1.3 Future Production Promotion Governance Gate Criteria
promotion_criteria.description: Explicit technical criteria that must be satisfied before Mathiyon SLM v1.3 could be considered for production promotion.

criteria_list.name: Stable Benchmark Behavior
criteria_list.required_threshold: 300/300 successful benchmark prompt executions with 0 runtime exceptions.

criteria_list.name: Zero Regression in Platform Test Suite
criteria_list.required_threshold: 100% pass rate across PyTest suite, Master E2E suite, PDF extraction, RAG security checks, and npm build.
criteria_list.current_status: SATISFIED (27/27 PyTest, 10/10 E2E, PDF, RAG, Build passed in Phase 11.9)

criteria_list.name: Reliable Tool Routing
criteria_list.required_threshold: 100% correct intent classification and tool dispatch across General, Math, Code, Document, and Web Search.

criteria_list.name: Reliable SymPy Math Engine Routing
criteria_list.required_threshold: 100% of exact math queries routed to SymPy engine; SLM never used as sole authoritative calculator.
criteria_list.current_status: SATISFIED (Enforced by architecture and verified in Phase 11.9)

criteria_list.name: Acceptable Generation Throughput
criteria_list.required_threshold: Minimum >30 tok/s mean autoregressive throughput on target CPU host.
criteria_list.current_status: SATISFIED (Achieved ~46-59 tok/s with FP32 + KV cache)

criteria_list.name: Acceptable Memory Footprint
criteria_list.required_threshold: KV cache memory overhead <=30MB per active sequence at 1024 context window.

criteria_list.name: Low Repetition Rate
criteria_list.required_threshold: Repetition rate <= 2.0% across benchmark evaluation suite.

criteria_list.name: Robust Instruction & Format Following
criteria_list.required_threshold: Valid structural formatting for JSON, bullet lists, code blocks, and step-by-step responses.
criteria_list.current_status: SATISFIED (Structural format checks passed in Phase 11.9)

criteria_list.name: Successful Shadow Evaluation
criteria_list.required_threshold: Minimum 1,000 requests processed via isolated shadow traffic without user impact or errors.
criteria_list.current_status: NOT SATISFIED (Shadow evaluation designed in Phase 11.10, pending execution in Phase 11.11)

criteria_list.name: Instant Rollback Capability
criteria_list.required_threshold: Ability to revert 100% of traffic to v1.2 within <1 second via feature flag / endpoint routing.
criteria_list.current_status: SATISFIED (Production endpoint POST /generate is isolated to v1.2)

promotion_criteria.overall_gate_status: PENDING SHADOW EVALUATION (Phase 11.11 Required Before Promotion Sign-Off)
